headline: China Central Bank Launches $15B Asset Swap to Support Stock Market
summary: The People's Bank of China announced a new round of a swap facility to channel about $15 billion into the onshore stock market following a severe sell-off.
why: Central bank market interventions and liquidity facilities are critical for stabilizing domestic financial systems and restoring investor confidence during major market downturns.
why_moved: The introduction of a $15 billion liquidity facility by the central bank directly aims to counteract heavy selling pressure and restore capital inflows to the onshore stock market.
